name: Low-Oil Bhindi Masala
ingredients: 250 g okra, washed, dried and cut in rings
½ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp red chilli powder
steps: Dry okra thoroughly (wet okra turns slimy). Heat the oil in a wide non-stick pan and cook the okra on medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the stickiness is gone. Set aside.
In the same pan, crackle the cumin and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 5 minutes until thick.
Return the okra, sprinkle in the besan and toss for 3 minutes.
Add the crumbled tofu with the besan and toss until golden.
note: Cooking the okra uncovered and dry keeps it from going slimy without deep-frying.
